clauses.reason: The sole paragraph restates section 4(b) of Executive Order 12369 so that the Committee terminates on 1983-10-30 unless sooner extended, in order to extend the life of the President’s Private Sector Survey on Cost Control in the Federal Government. The same sentence was rewritten by EO 12447 (signed 1983-10-27, date 1983-12-31) and EO 12455 (signed 1983-12-29, date 1984-01-31), which are later events that change the date and not ends of this clause. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 orders that the listed Executive Orders, "any amendments thereto, are revoked:" and lists the number 12429 in the No. column of its revocation table (offset 27022 of the held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12553.txt). This is an express revocation that names this order. EO 12553 has no effective-date wording, so the first-end date is its signing date, 1986-02-25; that is a reading of the text, not express wording, and the Federal Register publication date 1986-03-03 and filing date 1986-02-26 are not effective dates. Executive Order 12534 (signed 1985-09-30, effective 1985-09-30 by its section 5, held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12534.txt) revokes the parent Executive Order 12369, (b) Executive Order No. 12369 establishing the President’s Private Sector Survey on Cost Control in the Federal Government, reciting committees that have terminated or been abolished by statute or whose work is completed; it names the parent order but not this amending order, so under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on unnamed instruments it is disclosed as an earlier candidate and not adopted as the end.

The dossier evidence ACT:EO:12429>EO:12553 (agent-located, independently reviewed) was re-read against the held EO 12553 text, whose revocation table lists 12429. EO 12447 (1983-10-27) and EO 12455 (1983-12-29) restate the same sentence with later dates, and EO 12534 (1985-09-30) revokes the parent EO 12369 without naming EO 12429. Under the owner rulings of 2026-10-21 and 2026-10-28 the end is EO 12553 with the later sunset amendments and the parent revocation disclosed.
